summary: Model lean published at 8:44 ET, the first under the new rule: a total where our calibrated number clears the price by 2 points or more with nothing sourced against it. Raiders at Chargers under 43.5 at BetMGM -108, confidence 3, not a favorite. Cleveland at Tampa Bay over 41.5 also clears the bar on the number but the forecast has storms over the second half, so it stays a pass. Nothing settled, nothing closed.

gamePicks.title: Raiders at Chargers under 43.5
gamePicks.quoteNote: BetMGM's price from the 4:50 AM ET capture across five books; DraftKings, FanDuel and ESPN BET had -110 and BetRivers -109 at the same number.
gamePicks.edge: v2 total 40.2 (80% range 23.8 to 56.6). Chance of under 43.5: 54.3% (v2's raw 60.2% shrunk by its 2024-25 record against the close), against 51.9% break-even at -108: +2.4 points, +0.046u per unit.
gamePicks.cutoff: UNDER 43.5 at -108 or better. Closed to new entries at 42 or lower, or at -123 or worse at 43.5.
gamePicks.why: Model lean, published on our number alone. Our total is 40.2 against 43.5 and the under reads 54.3% after calibration, 2.4 points over what -108 needs. Brock Bowers is doubtful with a knee and Ladd McConkey questionable with a rib, which leans the same way, but the total has held 43.5 at every book through five captures since Saturday and two defensive backs are out, so none of that is a sourced edge beyond the model. Published so the model's totals build a live record of their own.
gamePicks.risk: One game of history for both teams; a thin model number is the model's most common error, and a market that has not moved knows things the model does not. Indoors at SoFi Stadium, so weather is no help either way. A quarter-unit of conviction, not a favorite.
